Behaviour (recent viewing, billing failures) matters more than demographics. No single signal is strong.

text: The churn model (XGBoost) has test ROC-AUC 0.65 (CV 0.661). That is weak: all four candidate models tie. It works as a RANKING tool: the top-risk 10% of customers churn at 44.9% versus a 24.9% base rate, the bottom 10% at 8.5%. It cannot reliably call an individual customer.
